title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
abstract: arXiv:2610.42112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. translated_title: 基于分层树结构索引器的次二次复杂度注意力机制
translated_abstract: 注意力的二次方扩展是限制大语言模型（LLM）长上下文能力的一个根本瓶颈。已有多种方法试图规避这一问题，但它们要么无法匹配注意力机制的表达能力（例如滑动窗口或具有固定大小状态的线性注意力变体），要么只能实现常数因子的加速（例如稀疏注意力方法，其索引器本身的复杂度仍是二次方量级）。在本文中，我们基于分层树结构索引器推导出一种渐近次二次复杂度的稀疏注意力方法，我们将其称为 Zyphra 分层注意力。ZHA 在 KV 缓存之上构建一棵由递归压缩的键摘要组成的树，后续的查询从树顶向下遍历，以检索出一个稀疏的键子集。至关重要的是，通过迭代地增加树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力计算在内的总成本随序列长度呈次线性增长……
tldr: 本文提出 Zyphra 分层注意力（ZHA），通过在 KV 缓存上构建递归压缩键摘要的树结构索引器，使包含路由在内的总计算成本随序列长度次线性增长，从而突破了注意力二次方复杂度对大语言模型长上下文能力的根本限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA), a sparse attention method built on a hierarchical tree-structured indexer of recursively compressed key summaries, whose total cost including routing grows sublinearly with sequence length, overcoming the quadratic attention bottleneck for long-context LLMs.
